_about: T-082a gate 1: hand-labelled questions. `cap` is copied by hand from ADR-014 §3.4 / §6.1 (orchestrator ≤ 24k, branch ≤ 16k input tokens per call), never from the code. `skills` are the skills the Manager (or the branch) has loaded; `reads` is how many read results (one synthetic 50-row page of each skill template in turn) sit in the history; `thread`, `investigation` and `hints` say which run blocks are present; `propose` marks a draft_request (proposal tools bound, one skill). Rows marked heavy are over the cap without compaction (§6.2).
